title: TRAITS OF A BORN AGAIN CHRISTIAN
memory_verse: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold all things are become new.
introduction: Repentance starts from a godly sorrow which leads to salvation. The sorrow is as a result of the thought of your previous ways of life before your encounter with Christ. The unpleasant lifestyle looks irritating to you and you accepted Christ as your Lord in order to have a change of ways. This new life have some traits which must be obvious to people. If your lifestyle has not change after giving your life to Christ, then you have to examine your salvation again. There must be a change in behaviour (Rom 6:4)
topic: TRAITS OF A BORN AGAIN CHRISTIAN
lesson_aim: Being born again must reflect in your behaviour
application: If truly you are born again, it must show in your behaviour. Are these mentioned traits showing in you.
raw_text:
TOPIC: TRAITS OF A BORN AGAIN CHRISTIAN
AIM: Being born again must reflect in your behaviour
MEMORY VERSE: II Cor 5:17; Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold all things are become new.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Ephesians 4:20-32
INTRODUCTION
Repentance starts from a godly sorrow which leads to salvation. The sorrow is as a result of the thought of your previous ways of life before your encounter with Christ. The unpleasant lifestyle looks irritating to you and you accepted Christ as your Lord in order to have a change of ways. This new life have some traits which must be obvious to people. If your lifestyle has not change after giving your life to Christ, then you have to examine your salvation again. There must be a change in behaviour (Rom 6:4)
LESSON OUTLINES
OLD THINGS HAVE PASSED AWAY (Eph 4:23):
Immediately you give your life to Christ, there must be an attitudinal change. Your behaviour must change from what it used to be, this must be physically evident because your old ways of life must irritate you. The old ways of life are the things that must pass away. Your encounter with Christ is to change your behaviour and not only about joining a new group called Christian
TRAITS OF A GENUINE CHRISTIAN:
He always show love (Eph 5:2)
He always forgive
He does not hurt people
He is compassionate
He is a light and he shines everywhere (Matt 5:14)
He is tolerant and accommodating
He works to feed and help other (Eph 4:28)
His utterances are comforting and truth Eph (4:29)
Fellowships with brethren in order to grow (Heb 10:24-25)
He does not pretend (Eph 4:20-22)
LESSON APPLICATION
If truly you are born again, it must show in your behaviour. Are these mentioned traits showing in you.

title: AWON IWA KRISTENI TI O TI DI ATUNBI
memory_verse: Nitorina bi enikeni ba wa ninu Kristi, o di eda titun: ohun atijo ti koja lo; kiyesi i, nwon si di titun.
introduction: Ironupiwada bere nipa nini ibanuje okan ododo ti yio mu igbala wa. Ibanuje okan yi ma sele nitori ironu nipa igbeaye ti eniyan ti ngbe tele ki eniyan to ba Kristi pade. Awon igbeaye ti o dun mo ti ko dun mo eniyan yi  je irira si, o si gba Jesu Kristi ni Oluwa re, ki o ba le ni iyipada ni igbeaye re. Igbeaye titun yi ni awon iwa ti o gbodo farahan si gbogbo eniyan. Ti igbeaye re o ba yipada lehin ti o fi aye re fun Kristi, o ye ki o tun igbala re ye wo. Iyipada gbogbo fara han ninu iwa re. (Rom 6:4)
topic: AWON IWA KRISTENI TI O TI DI ATUNBI

application: Ti o ba je looto ni o ti di atunbi, o gbodo farahan ninu iwa re. Se awon iwa wonyi nfarahan lara re?

title: CHRISTIAN PRAYER
memory_verse: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint.
introduction: Prayer is a church and Christian regular activity. There is no way a service would be conducted without prayer. In most cases, we start and end the service with prayer. After the general gathering, the time people pray is when they what to eat or they have overwhelming challenges. It is a way of communication between God and man. It is a way of making our thoughts known to God.
lesson_aim: Prayer is more than routine; it is a way of building good relationship with God.
application: Prayer is very important to build a cordial relationship with God
raw_text:
TOPIC: CHRISTIAN PRAYER
AIM: Prayer is more than routine; it is a way of building good relationship with God.
MEMORY VERSE: Luke 18:1; And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Colossians 4:2
INTRODUCTION
Prayer is a church and Christian regular activity. There is no way a service would be conducted without prayer. In most cases, we start and end the service with prayer. After the general gathering, the time people pray is when they what to eat or they have overwhelming challenges. It is a way of communication between God and man. It is a way of making our thoughts known to God.
LESSON OUTLINES
WHY SHOULD WE PRAY?
Prayer is a communication between man and God. Prayer helps to foster the relationship between man and God. What makes two friends to be close is communication. So prayer, which is communication between man and God, make our relationship with God to be deeper. Through prayer we make our intentions, request, feelings and others known to God. And in return, God speaks to us by revealing secret things to us. He may reveal His plan for our life, the plans of the enemy and other mysteries that we would not have known if we did not pray.
We should not see prayer as a task, but as something we need to do with a friend which we cherish our relationship with.
OTHER SIGNIFICANCE OF PRAYER:
Prayer helps you get direction to your life.
Prayer align your will to Godâs will
Prayer works miracle
Prayer gives you peace and confidence (1 Sam 30:8).
Prayer is important to our spiritual growth
Prayer makes us more compassionate person
Prayer makes us stay hopeful in dark times
Prayer makes us connect to God on a deeper level
LESSON APPLICATION
Prayer is very important to build a cordial relationship with God

title: EFFECTIVE CHRISTIAN PRAYER
memory_verse: The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much
introduction: Through prayer, we bring our problems and challenges to God in order to get solutions. There are different forms of prayer; Thanksgiving, confession, petition and intercessions. We want our request to be granted, but there are requirements to effective prayers, that is prayers that bring answers.
lesson_aim: To reveal the requirement for an effective prayer and reasons why answers may be delayed.
application: The Prayer of a righteous Christian performs wonders, God hears all the prayers, though it may be delayed, but it is never denied.
raw_text:
TOPIC: EFFECTIVE CHRISTIAN PRAYER
AIM: To reveal the requirement for an effective prayer and reasons why answers may be delayed.
MEMORY VERSE: James 5:16; The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much
BIBLE PASSAGE: James 1:5-8
INTRODUCTION
Through prayer, we bring our problems and challenges to God in order to get solutions. There are different forms of prayer; Thanksgiving, confession, petition and intercessions. We want our request to be granted, but there are requirements to effective prayers, that is prayers that bring answers.
LESSON OUTLINES
REQUIREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE PRAYER:
You should pray in the name of Jesus (John 14:13-14, John 16:23-24)
Righteousness (Psalm 34:15, Isaiah 59:1-2, Psalm 66:18-20, Mark 11:25, Isaiah 64:6)
Holy Spirit (Rom 8:26-27)
Our prayer must be according to Godâs will (James 4:1-6, Psalm 66:18)
Faith (James 1:5-8, Matt 11:23-24)
Persistence (Luke 18:1-7, Col 4:2, I Thess 5:17)
Fasting (Neh 1:9, Dan 9:3-4, Matt 6:16, Mark 9:29)
REASONS WHY ANSWER MAY BE DELAYED- The will of God and the Timing
We pray to know the will of God and that the will of God should to pass in our lives. At times, our pray may be the will of God for our lives, but the time for the fulfilment is not ripe. There is time for everything (Eccl 3:1). The children of Israel were promised salvation though Jesus Christ, until Christ was born that the promise was fulfilled (Luke 2:25-32). (Hab 2:3)
LESSON APPLICATION
The Prayer of a righteous Christian performs wonders, God hears all the prayers, though it may be delayed, but it is never denied.

title: IBASEPO TI OLORUN SETO
memory_verse: Ma fi ayo ba aya re gbe ti iwo fe ni gbogbo ojo aiye asan re, ti o fi fun o labe orun ni gbogbo ojo asan re, nitori eyini ni ipin tire li aiye yi, ati ninu lala ti iwo se labe orun.
introduction: Ayipada nba bi a se ngbe igbe aye wa, asa wa, isin, oselu ati igbagbo wa pelu. Awon ngbiyanju lati so wipe awon si labe itoni enikeni tabi enikeni kole so bi awon yio se gbe aye won. Ni opolopo igba, awon nkan ti won nse labe ominira yi lodi si ilakale igbagbo. Ayipada yi de ba igbeyawo bakanna, orisirisi awon asa nini iyawo ni o wa lari awon odo, won gba wipe awon le wa ninu ibasepo eyikeyi ti o ba wu awon. Eko oni da lori awon orisirisi ibasepo igbalode, ki a si se agbeyewo boya o ba idi igbeyawo mu.
lesson_aim: Olorun ni o da igbeyawo sile, a si gbodo se ni ona ti o te Olorun lorun.
application: Igbeyawo gbodo mu idi meteeta ti a fi gbe kale yi se, gbogbo igbeyawo yato si okunrin kan ati obirin kan yio mu aini ifokanbale dani.
raw_text:
AKORI EKO: IBASEPO TI OLORUN SETO
ERONGBA: Olorun ni o da igbeyawo sile, a si gbodo se ni ona ti o te Olorun lorun.
AKOSORI: Oniwasu 9:9; Ma fi ayo ba aya re gbe ti iwo fe ni gbogbo ojo aiye asan re, ti o fi fun o labe orun ni gbogbo ojo asan re, nitori eyini ni ipin tire li aiye yi, ati ninu lala ti iwo se labe orun.
BIBELI KIKA: Matteu 19:3-8
ORO AKOSO
Ayipada nba bi a se ngbe igbe aye wa, asa wa, isin, oselu ati igbagbo wa pelu. Awon ngbiyanju lati so wipe awon si labe itoni enikeni tabi enikeni kole so bi awon yio se gbe aye won. Ni opolopo igba, awon nkan ti won nse labe ominira yi lodi si ilakale igbagbo. Ayipada yi de ba igbeyawo bakanna, orisirisi awon asa nini iyawo ni o wa lari awon odo, won gba wipe awon le wa ninu ibasepo eyikeyi ti o ba wu awon. Eko oni da lori awon orisirisi ibasepo igbalode, ki a si se agbeyewo boya o ba idi igbeyawo mu.
PINPIN EKO
AWON IBASEPO IGBALODE
Igbeyawo ti o sile: Eleyi iru igbeyawo ti adehun wa larin okunrin ati obinrin wipe awon le ni enikeni miran lati ni ibalopo pelu, ti enikeji o si gbodo jowu..
Omiran ni igbeyawo oni adehun wipe okunrin ati obirin na yio fe ara won fun igba die (won o ti jo mo iye odun na), won o si pinya. Enikeni ninu awon mejeji le san owo fun enikeji nigbati won ba pin.
Igbeyawo ti okunrin kan yi o fe obirin meji, meta, merin ati bebelo.
Igbeyawo ti obirin kan yi o fe okunrin meji, meta, merin ati bebelo.
Igbeyawo ti obirin meji fe ara won.
Igbeyawo ti okunrin meji fe ara won.
PATAKI IGBEYAWO
Fun ajumokegbe: Eleyi ni lati ni eniyan lati ba jiroro, ki won si jo ni Alafia papo. Awon igbeyawo igbalode yi le gba alafia eyikeyi ninu awon ti won jo wa ninu ibasepo yi.
Fun omo bibi: Igbeyawo je igbekale lati mu eto Olorun nipa ibisi se. Eto Olorun nipe omo yio ma waye lati ara okunrin ati obirin laisi agbere ati pansaga. Awon miran lara awon eto igbeyawo igbalode yi kole mu eyi se. .
O je ona lati sa fun agbere. Ara idi ti igbeyawo fi waye ni ki a te ara wa lorun nipa ibalopo. Okunrin kan ati obirin kan. Awon miran ninu awon ilana igbeyawo igbalode yi nran agbere ati pansaga lowo. (1 Kor 7:12)
IGBEYAWO TI OLORUN LA KALE:
Okunrin kan ati Obirin kan, ki won si di okan (Matt 19:4-5)
Awon meeji yio jo gbepo lati te ara won lorun (1 Kor 7:3-4)
Awon mejeeji jo gba pe irin ajo titi lailai ni, titi iku yio fi ya won (Matt 19:8)
Ti awon mejeeji je orison itunu fun ara won (Gen 24:67)
Ti okunrin ati Obirin mu itunu ba awon obi awon mejeeji (Gen 26:34-35)
LILO EKO NA
Igbeyawo gbodo mu idi meteeta ti a fi gbe kale yi se, gbogbo igbeyawo yato si okunrin kan ati obirin kan yio mu aini ifokanbale dani.

memory_verse: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
introduction: Things are changing and it is affecting our ways of life, our culture, worship, politics and even our faith. People are trying to act liberal that they are free to do whatever they wish. At times things they do as a result of this freedom are contrary to the principle and guideline of our faith. raw_text:
TOPIC: GODâS ORDAINED UNION
AIM: Marriage was established by God and must be practice the way it pleases God.
MEMORY VERSE: Ecclesiastes 9:9; Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Matthew 19:3-8
INTRODUCTION
Things are changing and it is affecting our ways of life, our culture, worship, politics and even our faith. People are trying to act liberal that they are free to do whatever they wish. At times things they do as a result of this freedom are contrary to the principle and guideline of our faith. Marriage is not exempted from this change. There are different forms of marriage among the youths, people believe they can be in any relationship they like. Todayâs lesson focused on different forms of modern union and to examine if the unions meet the purpose of marriage.
LESSON OUTLINES
MODERN UNIONS
Open Marriage: This is an agreement to marry and each partner can have any other sex partners, any other married partners should not be jealous.
Contract marriage: An agreement to marry for some years and they part ways. Any of the partners can pay the other off depending on the person bringing the idea.
Polygamy: A union in which man married more than a woman.
Polyandry: A union in which a woman married more than a man
Lesbianism: A union in which two women married themselves.
Gayism: A union in which two men married themselves.
PURPOSE OF MARRIAGE
Companionship: Having someone to discuss and relate with, then enjoy peace together. Some of these new forms of marriage will take the peace of a partner away.
Procreation: Marriage is designed as an establishment to fulfil Godâs plan of bringing new life to the world. The plan of God is that children are to be born through the union of the husband and wife without fornication. Some of the listed unions above cannot achieve this.
To avoid fornication: The reason for marriage is to satisfy each other sexually. A man to a woman. Open marriage, polygamy and polyandry aid fornication. (1 Cor 7:12)
THE MARRIAGE GOD ORDAINED:
A man to a woman union and they become one (Matt 19:4-5)
Where both live to satisfy the other (1 Cor 7:3-4)
Where both accept that it is a journey of forever, till death separate them (Matt 19:8)
Where both are source of comfort to each other (Gen 24:67)
Where the man and the woman bring comfort to their parents (Gen 26:34-35)
LESSON APPLICATION
Marriage should achieve all the three purposes of its establishment, all other forms of marriage apart from a man and a woman union will lead to discomfort.

raw_text:
TOPIC: FAMILY FINANCE
AIM: Sacrifice is the foundation for successful family finance
MEMORY VERSE: Proverbs 27:23; Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
BIBLE PASSAGE: I Timothy 5:8
INTRODUCTION
The success of family finance depends largely on the understanding that marriage is about sacrifice and that you are living for each other. Irrespective of who earns more, there will not be problem if both parties understand this. The economy situation has made it necessary for both parties to be contributor in the family finances. There is no need to put pressure on a particular person (either husband or wife), it may lead to untimely death, but we should understand that we are in the ship together and it demand cooperation.
LESSON OUTLINES
JESUS AND THE CHURCH AS PERFECT EXAMPLE:
Jesus loves the church and offered himself as sacrifice for the church (Eph 5:25). As husband and wife, we should be ready to commit ourselves to the affairs of the home. Commitment is the last level of love, which is given all we have to things that pertain to the wellbeing and the future of the home. No partner should be selfish. Some partners would have eaten before coming home, and would not bother if the other partner and the children have eaten. It is not a godly behaviour.
UNDERSTAND THE SYSTEM THAT WORKS FOR YOU:
The perfect situation is to maintain same purse/account. God wants us to be one in all that we do as husband and wife, but there is another alternative, which is maintaining separate accounts. For peace to reisgn in our home, we should understand the system that would not cause conflict. The most important thing is that each partner should be honest to the other and be financially committed to the home affairs. Family should have pursuits and every member should contribute towards the achievement.
LESSON APPLICATION
Be willing to sacrifice for the progress of your family

title: ETO ISUNA NINU ILE
memory_verse: Iwo ma saniyan ati mo wa agbo eran re, ki iwo ki o si bojuto awon owo-eran re.
introduction: Aseyori eto isuna ninu ile da lori nini oye wipe igbeyawo je fifi ara-eni-rubo ati wipe a ngbe aye wa fun enikeji wa. Enikeni ti o wu ki o ni owo ju, ko ni si wahala ti awon mejeeji ba ni oye yi. Oro aje orile ede ti je ko di dandan pe ki oko ati iyawo jo ma ni owo ninu eto isuna ile. Ko ye ki a ma daamu enikan (boya oko tabi iyawo) fun owo ni igba gbogbo, o le fa iku aitojo, sugbon ajo wa ninu oko kan na ni, o si nilo ifowosowopo awa mejeeji.
lesson_aim: Ifi ara-eni-rubo je ipile fun aseyori eto isuna ninu ile
raw_text:
AKORI EKO: ETO ISUNA NINU ILE
ERONGBA: Ifi ara-eni-rubo je ipile fun aseyori eto isuna ninu ile
AKOSORI: Owe 27:23; Iwo ma saniyan ati mo wa agbo eran re, ki iwo ki o si bojuto awon owo-eran re.
BIBELI KIKA: I Timoteu 5:8
ORO AKOSO
Aseyori eto isuna ninu ile da lori nini oye wipe igbeyawo je fifi ara-eni-rubo ati wipe a ngbe aye wa fun enikeji wa. Enikeni ti o wu ki o ni owo ju, ko ni si wahala ti awon mejeeji ba ni oye yi. Oro aje orile ede ti je ko di dandan pe ki oko ati iyawo jo ma ni owo ninu eto isuna ile. Ko ye ki a ma daamu enikan (boya oko tabi iyawo) fun owo ni igba gbogbo, o le fa iku aitojo, sugbon ajo wa ninu oko kan na ni, o si nilo ifowosowopo awa mejeeji.
PINPIN EKO
JESU ATI IJO GEGEBI APEERE PIPE:
Jesu feran ijo, o si fi ara rubo fun ijo (Efe 5:25). Gegebi oko ati iyawo, agbodo setan lati fi ara wa ji fun gbodo eto ile wa. Ifara-eni-ji je ipele ti o kehin ninu ife, o je fifi oun gbogbo ti o ni kale fun alafia ati ojo waju ile . A ko gbodo ke aladanikan je tabi onimotara eni nikan. Oko tabi Iyawo miran yio ti jeun ki o to de ile, ko si ni bikita boya enikeji re ati awon omo ti jeun. Ki i se iwa ti o ba ti Olorun mu.
E JO NI OYE ETO ISUNA TI YIO SISE NINU ILE YIN:
Eto isuna ti o dara ju ni ki e so ma lo apo ifowopamo kan na. Olorun fe ki a je okan ninu gbogbo nkan ti a ba nse gegebi oko ati iyawo, sugbon ti eleyi o ba ni sise fun wa, ki a ya apo ifowopamo wa si otooto. Ki alafia le joba ninu ile, a gbodo mo eto isuna ti ko ni fa wahala. Oun ti o se Pataki ni ki a je olooto si ara wa, ki a ni owo ninu eto isuna ile. Idile gbodo ni ilepa, gbogbo ara inu ile si gbodo ni owo ninu aseyori ilepa na.
LILO EKO NAA
Je ki o ti okan re wa lati yonda ohunkohun fun itesiwaju ile re

INTRODUCTION

Irrespective of the stage of the relationship (number of years in marriage), everyone wants to be loved and have tangible reason for staying in a relationship.
LESSON OUTLINES
CAUSES OF PROBLEMS IN HOMES:
Inadequate preparation for marriage
Incompatibility of lifestyle
Dishonest behaviour
Infertility
Lack of commitment
Constant argument about believes
Parent intrusion/interference
WAYSTO AVOID PROBLEM IN OUR HOMES
Each partner should surrender to the leading of the Holy Spirit, this will make your home an enviable one.
Each partner should show love and empathy to the other as Jesus Christ showed love to the church.
Christianity does not mean that we should not spice up our relationship, do things that will make your relationship to grow and strong.

Lack of money or child should be taken to God in prayer.
Avoid ungodly or unpleasant interference from anyone (including parents)
LESSON APPLICATION
Relationship is like a seed/plant, water it and give it the necessary nutrients

raw_text:
TOPIC: THE PATTERN OF A CHRISTIANâS HOME
AIM: To know the pattern of Godâs arrangement for Christian home
MEMORY VERSE: Titus 2:7; In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good worksâ¦ BIBLE PASSAGE: Titus 2:1-14
INTRODUCTION
A Christian family is an institution where parents are bound together by Christian love, where children are happy and spiritually instructed. It is a home Where the Lord Jesus is the Supreme head of the home. A Christian family is one that Radiates Christ and dispenses hospitality.
A Christian family consists of God- fearing parents and Children. The Christian family is the bedrock of the nation and the glory of the Christian church. May God give us a good  Christian home.
LESSON OUTLINES
DUTIES OF THE FATHER
It is ordained by God that the husband should be the head of the home Ephesians 5:2, Gen. 18:19.
It is the duty of the husband to love his wife as himself â Eph 5: 25, CoL3:19. This is the love expressed in 1 Corinthians 13
The husband is required to be faithful to his wife.
It is the husbandâs duties to comfort his wife
He ought to consult with his wife on business matters and issues that affect the home, for they are a team.
The Christian husband should always put God first in his life â Luke 14: 26.
He is the priest of the home and he is responsible to establish a family altar for daily worship. He is to listen and lead his wife with wise counsel â 2 Kings 4:8-10, Eccles. 4:9-11.
DUTIES OF THE MOTHERS IN THE HOME
The wife is to obey her husband â Eph 5: 22, 1 Peter 3:6.
Wives are not only to respect their husbands but they are to love them too â Titus 2:4.
The woman is not to be adorned with ornaments -1 Tim. 2:9-10. Instead, wives are to be adorned with good work, including modesty and sobriety, Meekness and have a quiet spirit â 1 Peter 3:4-5.
A Christian wife must be trustworthy, hardworking and be an early riser Proverbs 31: 11, 13, 15.
THE DUTIES OF BOTH PARENTS
Parents are to realize that their children really belong to God (Psalm 127:3-5).
Parents should bring their children to the Lord at an early age- Matthew 19:13-14 â to train and discipline them for the Lord- Proverbs 22:6. One way of making their task easy is to bring the children to Sunday School and church. Teach them Bible stories at home and give them a part in family prayers. Teach them to obey God and the law of the country â Deut. 32:46.
Parents are to provide for their children- 1 Tim.5:8 â and should be careful not to provoke their children to wrath â Ephesians 6:4.
Above all, let godly parents pray for their children. Pray that they would be saved to overcome sin.
THE DUTIES OF THE CHILDREN
Children are to honour their parents â Exodus 20: 12, obey them Luke 2:51, and pray for them.
They must also return their parentâs love, for love is a two-way traffic.
They must be sober and show good examples in all things â Titus 2:6-7.
Children must constantly remember that the children of today shall be the parents of tomorrow.
LESSON APPLICATION
The secret of a successful Christian home is in the family altar, where Christ is crowned the Head of the home. Love is the second secret. Parents should also remember they are all children with a loving Father above who constantly demonstrates His love.

memory_verse: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, tell us, when shall these things be? And what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
introduction: The end time or end of times, end of days, last days or final days represent the times and series of events that would proceed the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ or the end of the world. Although, the appropriate date or period of Christâs coming is not known by any person or angels except God, the Father only (Mark 13:32, Matthew 24:36). lesson_aim: To let us know that the signs of the end time are here with us

TOPIC: THE SIGNS OF END TIME ARE HERE
AIM: To let us know that the signs of the end time are here with us
MEMORY VERSE: Matthew 24:3: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, tell us, when shall these things be? And what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
BIBLE PASSAGE: Matthew 24:1-30
INTRODUCTION
The end time or end of times, end of days, last days or final days represent the times and series of events that would proceed the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ or the end of the world. Although, the appropriate date or period of Christâs coming is not known by any person or angels except God, the Father only (Mark 13:32, Matthew 24:36). The Bible, however, describes the signs that would herald His coming. We shall consider some of these signs and identify some preparations to prevent us from being caught unawares.
LESSON OUTLINES
THE SIGNS
The sign of the demotion of the temple. i.e no stone of the temple will be left upon another- Luke 21:56
Sign of abundance of iniquity- immorality, sexual perversion with similar sex and animal, covetousness and corruption, greed etc - 2Tim 3:2-3; 1Tim 3:3; Roman 1:27-30
Sign of increased knowledge- Dan 12:4
Signs of perilous times- 2Tim 3:2-8
Signs of many false teachers, prophets and satanic denominations- Rev 2:9; Rev 3:9, 2Pet 2:2; Mark 13:6
Sign of preaching of the gospel all over the world- Matthew24:14; Mk 13:10
Sign of calamities- earthquakes, war, famines, sorrows etc.- Matthew 24:6-7; Mark13:8
Sign of apostasy, backsliding, hypocrisy and betrayal in the Church- 2Tim 3:4; Matthew 24:12; 2Tim 4:4, Matthew 24:9; Mk 13:12
YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.
God warned his children to take heed lest they would be caught unawares. Here are some cautions for believers:
Take heed lest you fall- 1Corinth 10:12
Take heed lest any man deceive you- Mk 13:5
Take heed for they shall deliver you up to the Council- Mk13:9
Take heed of false prophets- Mk 13:22-23, Matthew 24:24
Take heed, watch and pray- Mk 13:33
Beware of sleeping instead of watching- Mk 13:35-37
Watch out for abomination of desolation in holy places-Matthew 24:15-21
LESSON APPLICATION
Some of the signs of the end times are already here. There will all be fulfilled. Therefore, Christians are to prepare, aware that the end must come and Christ must return again as promised- Act 1:11 Be wise. Be prepared because the signs of the end times are here

title: COUNSEL
memory_verse: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
introduction: No one is an island of knowledge. In our daily activity and decision making, we get advice and directives from people, who could be friends, wife, husband, parents or other family members. It is not all advice that can be applied. It is your responsibility to think over every counsel given to you and decide if to be used or discarded.
lesson_aim: Take a careful examination of advices before you apply them
application: The devil can use our flesh, friends or even people close to us with foolish talks. The devil can drive us into foolish conclusions and even foolish actions. You must remember that your Redeemer lives - Job 19:25 -and that weeping may endure for a night but joy comes in the morning - Psalm 30:5.
raw_text:
TOPIC: COUNSEL
AIM: Take a careful examination of advices before you apply them
MEMORY VERSE: II Chronicles 22:3; He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Job 2:9-10
INTRODUCTION
No one is an island of knowledge. In our daily activity and decision making, we get advice and directives from people, who could be friends, wife, husband, parents or other family members. It is not all advice that can be applied. It is your responsibility to think over every counsel given to you and decide if to be used or discarded.
LESSON OUTLINES
BE CAREFUL OF COUNSEL
People say a lot of things around us and some of the talks could be careless or foolish. They could come as casual talks or counsel. The talks could come from casual friends or even very close relations - 2 Chr. 22: 3. The wife of Job gave birth to ten children and was married for several years. Consider her counsel and her husband's response. Consider how people who are close could give counsels that would affect lives positively or otherwise - 2 Chronicles 10: 10, 11.
EXAMPLES OF FOOLISH COUNSELS
When we found ourselves in difficult condition, it is not good to give up. It means that our trust and hope in God is over. Consider the result of the spies in Numbers 13:30; 14:1-2. Consider Exodus 14:11-12 and Numbers 20:4-5. Note the result in Numbers 26: 65.
Some examples of foolish counsel in the Bible:
To sin - 2 Samuel 13:5.
For popularity - 2 Samuel 16:21.
Vengeance -1 Samuel 24: 4; Esther 5:14.
Envy - Esther 3:9; Daniel 6:8.
Add to the list
Give some examples of today's foolish talk, "Is death not better ... "
LESSON APPLICATION
The devil can use our flesh, friends or even people close to us with foolish talks. The devil can drive us into foolish conclusions and even foolish actions. You must remember that your Redeemer lives - Job 19:25 -and that weeping may endure for a night but joy comes in the morning - Psalm 30:5.

title: FOCUS
memory_verse: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
introduction: To be focused means to have a clear understanding of what you want to achieve and be able to concentrate your attention on it. It also means to get rid of distractions. Have you ever seen a photographer that opens his two eyes to the lens of a camera? He will open an eye to the lens of the camera and close the other eye to the other objects in order to get a clear image. Those things he closed the other eye for her distractions at the moment, irrespective of the value on them.
lesson_aim: To understand the importance of focus and get rid of possible distractions
application: Get rid of your distractions and stay focus on the goal you have set.
raw_text:
TOPIC: FOCUS
AIM: To understand the importance of focus and get rid of possible distractions
MEMORY VERSE: Matthew 6:22; The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Genesis 11:31
INTRODUCTION
To be focused means to have a clear understanding of what you want to achieve and be able to concentrate your attention on it. It also means to get rid of distractions. Have you ever seen a photographer that opens his two eyes to the lens of a camera? He will open an eye to the lens of the camera and close the other eye to the other objects in order to get a clear image. Those things he closed the other eye for her distractions at the moment, irrespective of the value on them.
LESSON OUTLINES
THE IMPORTANCE OF FOCUS
Being focus makes you have a plan
It gives meaning to your life
It makes manage your resources very well
It makes you productive (You use your time and energy effectively and efficiently)
It makes you principled, persevere and disciplined
WHAT ARE DISTRACTIONS
Distractions are things that make you deviate from your goals, you may start seeking pleasure and at the end you will be unfulfilled, empty and weary. Things that could be distractions;
Present pleasure
Excuses (lack of money)
Modern life and smart phone
Regrets
Thought of others
LESSON APPLICATION
Get rid of your distractions and stay focus on the goal you have set.

introduction: Our society is a reflection of the trainings from each home. Gambling, betting, indecent dressings, drugs are common in the society and the children doing these are from various homes. Father and son are meeting at the betting shop, beer parlour and brothel, mother and daughter know each otherâs concubine, children using money from immoral activities (prostitution, stealing, betting and many more) to feed the house.
lesson_aim: Guide your children rightly
application: Do not give room for chances; it is your responsibility to guide your children in the right way. Be responsible financially.
raw_text:
TOPIC: PARENTAL COUNSEL
AIM: Guide your children rightly
MEMORY VERSE: II Timothy 1:5; When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Jer 35:1-10
INTRODUCTION
Our society is a reflection of the trainings from each home. Gambling, betting, indecent dressings, drugs are common in the society and the children doing these are from various homes. Father and son are meeting at the betting shop, beer parlour and brothel, mother and daughter know each otherâs concubine, children using money from immoral activities (prostitution, stealing, betting and many more) to feed the house.
LESSON OUTLINES
GUIDE YOUR CHILDREN TO KNOW GOD
The first responsibility of parents is to ensure that their child/children know God. Achieving this will make them obtain good result in other aspect of life. Knowing God means having the fear of God. This will make them make godly decisions in the absence of the parent and live a live that pleases God. They will be a source of joy and bring peace to the parent, family and the society at large. (Prov 23:24)
GUIDE THEIR DECISION MAKING
Parents should be actively involved in the decision making of their children. This does not mean they should compel or force the child to their own will, but by allowing the child to see reasons why they are giving him/her the options to choose. Parent should guide the child in;
School/course selection
Their clothing
Skill/career decisions
Investment decision
Marital decision (Abraham told his servant to get a wife for his son among his people â Gen 24)
TAKE RESPONSIBILITY OF THEIR FINANCE
Many children have been exposed to activities beyond their age because their parents abandoned them to fend for themselves. Those children do not want to know if an activity is legal or illegal, so far it can fetch them money to make ends meets. As a result of this, the parents have no control over the children. Your ability to finance your child gives you a reasonable control over your child. So far you are paying for the childâs needs, he/she would not buy materials that would not please you, if he/she bought them, you have the gut to tell him/her to return them.
LESSON APPLICATION
Do not give room for chances; it is your responsibility to guide your children in the right way. Be responsible financially.

title: A SERVANT LEADER
memory_verse: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant
introduction: We have seen leadership position as avenue for enjoyment and control people, but it is a position of work. It is an avenue to serve people, to be committed to the things of others. It is to sacrificially seek the highest joy of others. A servant leader is not preoccupied with personal visibility and recognition, but seeks the glory of God.
lesson_aim: Leadership is to serve
application: The most efficient way to get the commitment of your followers is to show that you are committed and concern about the service and about them.
raw_text:
TOPIC: A SERVANT LEADER
AIM: Leadership is to serve
MEMORY VERSE: Matthew 23:11; But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant
BIBLE PASSAGE: Matthew 20:20-28
INTRODUCTION
We have seen leadership position as avenue for enjoyment and control people, but it is a position of work. It is an avenue to serve people, to be committed to the things of others. It is to sacrificially seek the highest joy of others. A servant leader is not preoccupied with personal visibility and recognition, but seeks the glory of God.
LESSON OUTLINES
CHARACTERISTICS OF A SERVANT LEADER
Listening
Empathy
Foresight
Commitment to growth of the people
Humility/Meekness
Stewardship
Integrity
Develop other leaders
Forgiving
Courageous
EXAMPLES OF SERVANT LEADERS
Nehemiah (Neh 5:1-19)
Moses (Exo 18:14-27)
David (I Sam 30:1-10)
John the Baptist (John 3:30-31)
Jesus Christ (John 13:1-7)

The most efficient way to get the commitment of your followers is to show that you are committed and concern about the service and about them.

title: AT THY WORD
memory_verse: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
introduction: God values His words more than His name (Psalm 138:2). Human being breaks promises but God does not break His promise (Num 23:19, Isaiah 55:11). His words are his covenant and He stands by them. God does not change (Mal 3:6, Heb 13:8). The fact that God is unchanging and unstoppable (Exo 3:14) makes Him reliable.
lesson_aim: Hold unto Godâs promises.
application: Do not look at the challenges, but let your focus be the expected end he has promised you.
raw_text:
TOPIC: AT THY WORD
AIM: Hold unto Godâs promises.
MEMORY VERSE: Luke 5:5; And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Luke 5:1-7
INTRODUCTION
God values His words more than His name (Psalm 138:2). Human being breaks promises but God does not break His promise (Num 23:19, Isaiah 55:11). His words are his covenant and He stands by them. God does not change (Mal 3:6, Heb 13:8). The fact that God is unchanging and unstoppable (Exo 3:14) makes Him reliable.
LESSON OUTLINES
REASONS WHY GOD GIVES PROMISES
To strengthen you during the storm. Most times, God always promise you ahead of the challenges that will come your way. So, the promise would be your hope all through the challenges (Job 19:25)
To give a little base to joy on
Promises give anchor to our soul
Promises make you live in a way that will confound the world
HAVE FAITH AND BE HOPEFUL
Take a careful examination of the life of our patriarchs, Abraham, Job, Noah, Joseph and others. They keep on having faith in God and hoping for the fulfilment of His promises. The reason why you should trust God is that He is limitless, nothing can stop Him whenever is ready to act. The prevailing condition may be indicating there is no hope (Gen 26), but hold unto His words and examine the life of our patriarchs.
LESSON APPLICATION
Do not look at the challenges, but let your focus be the expected end he has promised you.

title: WORK; THE RESPONSIBILTY OF CHRISTIANS
memory_verse: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work
introduction: Jesus Christ showed us example that we should work. All through his stay on earth he was moving from one place to another working. He evangelized (Acts 10:38), he was a responsible citizen by paying tax (Matt 17:27), he showed love and was compassionate (Matt 14:14), and He was a responsible child to His earthly parents (Mark 6:3, John 2:1-10). These are many more He expected from us as His followers (John 14:12). (John 10:37)
lesson_aim: Faith without work is dead.
application: Our genuine labour of love can never be in vain, work to get good reward at the end.
raw_text:
TOPIC: WORK; THE RESPONSIBILTY OF CHRISTIANS
AIM: Faith without work is dead.
MEMORY VERSE: John 9:4; I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work
BIBLE PASSAGE: I Corinthians 3:13-15
INTRODUCTION
Jesus Christ showed us example that we should work. All through his stay on earth he was moving from one place to another working. He evangelized (Acts 10:38), he was a responsible citizen by paying tax (Matt 17:27), he showed love and was compassionate (Matt 14:14), and He was a responsible child to His earthly parents (Mark 6:3, John 2:1-10). These are many more He expected from us as His followers (John 14:12). (John 10:37)
LESSON OUTLINES
THE WAYS CHRISTIANS SHOW SHOULD WORK
Be a responsible member in your community, by contributing financially, morally and physically to the development
Be a good role model to the younger ones.
Be a responsible husband/father or wife/mother.
Be a reliable staff and add value to the organisation.
Be a good counsellor/adviser
Be a responsible child
Be committed financially and physically to the propagation of the gospel and the growth of your church.
TIME:
Time is very important in work of God (Eccl 3:1). Use your time, energy and resource appropriately because time is coming the time and energy will not be available. The money may also not be available again. (John 9:4)
THE BASIS OF OUR REWARD
Our work will determine the reward we will get. Some people would get many rewards, while some people will get little and some will not get at all. (1 Cor 3:13). Our work will be tested, our intentions and motives will determine if our work is valuable or not. Some are working with eye service, some people are working just to please men or as a bribe for personal gratification.
LESSON APPLICATION
Our genuine labour of love can never be in vain, work to get good reward at the end.

title: FLEE SEXUAL IMMORALITIES
memory_verse: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
introduction: Sexual immorality referred to any type of sexual relations you have outside the boundaries God has set that violates sexual purity. Sexual immorality includes sexual sins such as fornication, adultery, incest, and homosexuality. God ordained sexual engagement is an activity between a man and a woman who are married, for procreation, enjoyment and bonding. Sexual immorality has been aided in our society through indecent dressing, television adverts and on phones.
lesson_aim: To learn how to guide against sexual immoralities
application: Bible emphasizes purity, sexual purity is not excluded. Be pure as your father in heaven.
raw_text:
TOPIC: FLEE SEXUAL IMMORALITIES
AIM: To learn how to guide against sexual immoralities
MEMORY VERSE: Proverbs 25:28; He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
BIBLE PASSAGE: I Thessalonians 4:3-8
INTRODUCTION
Sexual immorality referred to any type of sexual relations you have outside the boundaries God has set that violates sexual purity. Sexual immorality includes sexual sins such as fornication, adultery, incest, and homosexuality. God ordained sexual engagement is an activity between a man and a woman who are married, for procreation, enjoyment and bonding. Sexual immorality has been aided in our society through indecent dressing, television adverts and on phones.
LESSON OUTLINES
CAUSES OF SEXUAL IMMORALITY
Failure to set boundaries with other party.
Ungodly plays/conversations
Wrong associations
Desires of sinful nature
Sexual deprivation in marriage
HOW TO FLEE FROM SEXUAL IMMORALITIES
Avoid gatherings/friends that promote and discuss immoralities with you.
Mortify your flesh daily by reading the scripture and praying daily (Rom 8:13, Col 3:5)
Set boundaries and stop any ungodly play/conversation with opposite gender.
Partners should satisfy each other sexually (I Cor 7:2-5).
GOD IS THE AVENGER
For those sleeping with someone else partner, Bible said God is the avenger (I Thess 4:6), you know what it means to contend with God. It is a battle you cannot win. Run away from fornication, it irritates God and unpleasing in human society.
LESSON APPLICATION
Bible emphasizes purity, sexual purity is not excluded. Be pure as your father in heaven.

title: CHRIST, THE RESURRECTION AND LIFE
memory_verse: But thanks be to God, which giveth us victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
introduction: Easter is the annual remembrance of the death and resurrection of our Lord, Jesus Christ. It is significant to Christian because it is the foundation of our faith and it gave us a reliability of a life after death (I Cor 15:13-19). Jesus died to unite us with God by taking away our sins. Christianity has no stand if resurrection did not happen, we would have suffered in vain and placed our faith in false hope
lesson_aim: The death and resurrection of Jesus gave us hope of eternal life.
application: There is eternal life which has been secured through the death and resurrection of Christ, but you can all have the eternal life by reconciling with your maker. Let the purpose of His resurrection be fulfilled in your life.
raw_text:
TOPIC: CHRIST, THE RESURRECTION AND LIFE
AIM: The death and resurrection of Jesus gave us hope of eternal life.
MEMORY VERSE: I Cor 15:57; But thanks be to God, which giveth us victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
BIBLE PASSAGE: I Cor 15:51-58
INTRODUCTION
Easter is the annual remembrance of the death and resurrection of our Lord, Jesus Christ. It is significant to Christian because it is the foundation of our faith and it gave us a reliability of a life after death (I Cor 15:13-19). Jesus died to unite us with God by taking away our sins. Christianity has no stand if resurrection did not happen, we would have suffered in vain and placed our faith in false hope
LESSON OUTLINES
THE SIGNIFICANCE OF JESUSâ RESURRECTION:
Jesusâ resurrection is the Fatherâs signal that Jesus is His son and that he conquered death and he reign as Lord forever. As no one has ever died and woke from death. Rom 1:4, Rom 4: 25
Resurrection of Jesus Christ makes us to believe all His promises. If He did not rise after promising several times, none of His promises can be trusted. Matt 12:40, 16:21, 17:9 & 23, 20:19, 26:32.
Resurrection of Jesus Christ is the foundation of our apostolic faith. It is the bedrock of the new covenant. (Matt 16:18, Matt 26:31-32, I Cor 15:17)
Without resurrection of Jesus Christ, there will be no model for sacrificial living. Jesus lived a selfless life until his death. His resurrection was because of us, so He is an example to follow. (Matt 10:38-39, Acts 10:38-40)
Without resurrection, there will be no reckoning for sin (Acts 17:31)
THE HOPE WE HAVE
The most significant part of Easter is the hope of life after this world (Eternal life). He overcame death, he has power over it. So all the dead in Christ will be raised at the end and be with Him forever. The purpose of our dedication, commitment and perseverance is to reign with him at the end. His death and resurrection has given us the assurance that even though we die (physically), we shall live again (I Cor 15:19-20, I Thess 4:13-18)
LESSON APPLICATION
There is eternal life which has been secured through the death and resurrection of Christ, but you can all have the eternal life by reconciling with your maker. Let the purpose of His resurrection be fulfilled in your life.

title: STEP TO A MEANINGFUL LIFE
memory_verse: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
introduction: God has a good plan for everyone on earth, and He will never force His will on anyone. The way we live when we are grown up and can identify what is good and bad determines the fulfilment of His plan in our life. It is the responsibility of individual to determine to live a meaningful life or a worthless life.
lesson_aim: The step to a meaningful life starts with separation
application: Separate yourself from the world by embracing Jesus and start to live a meaningful life
raw_text:

INTRODUCTION
God has a good plan for everyone on earth, and He will never force His will on anyone. Worldliness means all things that do not conform to the will and desire of God. It is living a lifestyle that pleases the world and Satan. It is living unrighteous. It refers to all evil desires, lust, greed, fornication, deceit, evil ideology and all other way of life that does not glorify God.

Immoral lifestyle

False believe

To live a purposeful life
To have peace

Separate yourself from the world by embracing Jesus and start to live a meaningful life

title: SORA KI O SI MA GBADURA
memory_verse: E ma sona, ki e si ma gbadura, ki eyin ki o ma ba bo sinu idewo: loto li emi nfe sugbon o se alailera fun ara.
introduction: Ni ose ti o koja, a ko eko lori awon ota ti a nba jijakadi (eran ara, aye ati Sani pelu ogun re). Loni, a fe wo ona lati bori awon ota yi. Sisora tu mo si ki eniyan wa ni imurasile lati le mo awon ete ati irinse esu, ki a si gbadura fun agbara Olorun lati le bori esu ati awon irinse re.
topic: SORA KI O SI MA GBADURA
lesson_aim: Jije eniti nsora ati aladura ni ona lati bori ogun
raw_text:
AKORI EKO: SORA KI O SI MA GBADURA
ERONGBA: Jije eniti nsora ati aladura ni ona lati bori ogun
AKOSORI: Matt 26:41; E ma sona, ki e si ma gbadura, ki eyin ki o ma ba bo sinu idewo: loto li emi nfe sugbon o se alailera fun ara.
BIBELI KIKA: Efesu 6:10-18
ORO AKOSO
Ni ose ti o koja, a ko eko lori awon ota ti a nba jijakadi (eran ara, aye ati Sani pelu ogun re). Loni, a fe wo ona lati bori awon ota yi. Sisora tu mo si ki eniyan wa ni imurasile lati le mo awon ete ati irinse esu, ki a si gbadura fun agbara Olorun lati le bori esu ati awon irinse re.
PINPIN EKO
ISORA
O tumo si ki eniyan ma sun, ki o si ni afoju si. Kristeni je oluso, o si ye ki oju re wa ni lila. Bibeli fun wa ni apeere pe, ota fun epo sarin alikama nigbati eniyan sun. (Matt 13:25), Kristeni gbodo ni akiyesi, o gbodo ma so igbese awon ota re (II Kor 2:11) (gbogbo awon oun ti o farape idewo lo gbodo mo). A gbodo mo oro Olorun ki a ba le da ete ati irin esu mo. Ko si aye fun igbadun ati afeyeye nigbati a ba nse iso, koda ti a ti ni isegun lori awon ogun kookan, a gbodo tun ma sora ni.
ADURA
Kristeni ti ko ba le gbadura je Kristeni ti ko ni lagbara. Adura je ona ti a ngba ba Olorun soro, o si je ona ti a gba ni idapo pelu re (Joh 15:5). O je ona ti a gba fa ife wa le Olorun lowo. O je ona ti a ngba pe Olorun sinu ilakoja, idamu ati isoro wa. O je ona lati ri abo kuro lowo idojuko ota. Jesu pe awon omo ehin re nija pe, won o le ba  ohun sona fun wakati kan (Matt 26:40)
LILO EKO NAA
Ona lati bori ija emi ni ki a ma sora, ki a si ma gbadura

title: WATCH AND PRAY
memory_verse: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak
introduction: Last week, we studied the enemies in our warfare (the flesh, the world and Satan with his forces. Today, we want to examine the way to overcome these enemies. Watchfulness implies to guard carefully in order to identify Devilâs devices and schemes, and then pray for the power of God to overcome the devil and the devices.
lesson_aim: Being watchful and prayerful are the ways to overcome the warfare.
application: The way to overcome the spiritual warfare is through watchfulness and prayer
raw_text:
TOPIC: WATCH AND PRAY
AIM: Being watchful and prayerful are the ways to overcome the warfare.
MEMORY VERSE: Matt 26:41; Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak
BIBLE PASSAGE: Ephesians 6:10-18
INTRODUCTION
Last week, we studied the enemies in our warfare (the flesh, the world and Satan with his forces. Today, we want to examine the way to overcome these enemies. Watchfulness implies to guard carefully in order to identify Devilâs devices and schemes, and then pray for the power of God to overcome the devil and the devices.
LESSON OUTLINES
WATCHFULNESS
This is to keep awake and vigilant. A Christian is a watchman and expected to keep his/her eyes opened. The Bible gave the illustration of the enemy that sow tare among the wheat when the man slept (Matt 13:25), Christians are to be observant, knowing the movement of the enemies (II Cor 2:11) (All subtle temptations should be identified). We must know the word of God in order to recognize the devilâs devices and schemes. There is no time for pleasure while watching, even when we have overcome some battle, we must continue watching.
PRAYER
A prayerless Christian is a powerless Christian. Prayer is the way we talk to God and fellowship with God (John 15:5). It is the way we commit our desires to God. It is the way we call God into our situation, troubles and difficulty. It is a way to get protection from the attacks of the enemy. Jesus challenged His Disciples that they could not watch with Him in prayer for an hour (Matt 26:40)
LESSON APPLICATION
The way to overcome the spiritual warfare is through watchfulness and prayer

title: SIN IS A WASTER
memory_verse: If we suffer shall also reign with him: if we deny him he also will deny us
introduction: Sin is doing contrary to the instructions of God in the bible. It is always enticing, appealing and enjoyable, but it has bad consequences which is eternal death. It makes youth waste their time, resources and life. Because holy living demands sacrifices and self denial, which a lot are not ready to endure, so they commit sin in order to satisfy their cravings (lust) and live according to the world standard. Sin may be in any form; stealing, fornication, lie, disobedience, gossip, backbiting, malice, pretence and many more others.
lesson_aim: The target of sin is to destroy your life and destiny
application: The target of sin is to waste your time, resource and life. It may be pleasing, satisfying and enjoyable, the consequences are unbearable when it boomerang. Avoid sin as much as possible.

title: PERFECTION

introduction: As Christians, we are working towards perfection everyday. Jesus urged us to be perfect as our father in heaven. In order to achieve this, there many amendments we would do. The state of perfection is maturity level God wants us to reach.
lesson_aim: Perfection requires several corrections
application: Do you still have some secret sins you are committing, it is time to repent. God want us to be perfect and blameless.

The state of perfection is maturity level God wants us to reach.
LESSON OUTLINES
AMENDMENTS
This means identification of unpleasant or unacceptable ways and doing the correction immediately. These corrections can be the nature of our business, friends we associate with, pattern of dressing, the food and drinks we consume, secret behaviours that people did not know. Our heart should be regenerated that we will be ready to drop anything to please God. It is an act of genuine repentance and not eye service.

Study your bible regularly

Walk in the Spirit

Do you still have some secret sins you are committing, it is time to repent. God want us to be perfect and blameless.

title: INTIMACY WITH GOD
memory_verse: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
introduction: Intimacy is a state of having close relationship with someone or God. It is a deep friendship in which if one part has not heard the voice or seen the other, he/she is restless. David understood this relationship, he said as the deer panteth for the water brooks, so his soul after thee, O God (Psalm 42:1). Enoch enjoyed this closeness with God to the extent that God had to take him away. In intimate relationship, both parties enjoy the benefit of the closeness.

title: THE PRESENCE OF GOD
memory_verse: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles, one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
introduction: Experiencing the presence of God means having the knowledge and understanding that God is with you. It is different from the omnipresence of God, omnipresence of God means that God is everywhere, but the presence of God with a man means that the man possesses grace, favour, and a portion of the glory of God. It is a sweet experience which can be continuous, it makes you struggle-less in prayer and enjoy constant communication with God.
lesson_aim: The presence of God in a Christian life is a requisite for the journey.
application: We need the presence of God at all time in our life, we cannot do without that.
raw_text:
TOPIC: THE PRESENCE OF GOD
AIM: The presence of God in a Christian life is a requisite for the journey.
MEMORY VERSE: Matthew 17:4; Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles, one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Matthew 17:1-4
INTRODUCTION
Experiencing the presence of God means having the knowledge and understanding that God is with you. It is different from the omnipresence of God, omnipresence of God means that God is everywhere, but the presence of God with a man means that the man possesses grace, favour, and a portion of the glory of God. It is a sweet experience which can be continuous, it makes you struggle-less in prayer and enjoy constant communication with God.
LESSON OUTLINES
BENEFITS OF THE PRESENCE OF GOD IN YOUR LIFE
It makes you different â Exo 33:16-17
It gets rid of shame â II Kings 2:13-15
It gives you confidence in trying time â Luke 8:23
It gives you direction â Psalm 23:1-2
It brings favour and grace â I kings 17:4-6
DANGERS OF BEING A CHRISTIAN WITHOUT THE PRESENCE OF GOD
As a Christian, you are enlisted as a soldier, you are fighting the devil and his servants. A Christian without the presence of God is like an ordinary/natural man threatening or looking for devilâs trouble. The man is prone to attacks from the devil, he is powerless and vulnerable. Immediately the presence of God left Samson (Judges 16:19-20), he was captured. When the presence of God left Saul, he was troubled by evil spirit and he started misbehaving. (I Sam 16:14)
WHAT MAKES THE PRESENCE OF GOD TO LEAVE A MAN
Sin makes the presence of God to leave the life of any Christian.
Disobedient: Not following Godâs instruction totally as commanded.
Fornication/adultery
Pride
Taking the grace of God for granted.
LESSON APPLICATION
We need the presence of God at all time in our life, we cannot do without that.

title: THE BLESSING IN WORK
memory_verse: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather, working with his hands the things which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
introduction: Greediness is the reason many young people have fallen into traps or died untimely. They are in a hurry to make money from every possible means, either legal or illegal. Joseph followed through the process, he endured the hardship and enjoyed later. In other hand, Gezahi wants to outsmart his master and become rich suddenly, but it boomeranged. Youths are carrying out illegal activities to make quick money. Many of them are languishing in the prison, some were butchered by the people who financed the extravagant lifestyle, some have been used for ritual, and some have been sold to foreign lands as prostitute.
lesson_aim: Work is the legitimate means of making money
application: Do not be deceived, work is the legal route out of poverty.
raw_text:
TOPIC: THE BLESSING IN WORK
AIM: Work is the legitimate means of making money
MEMORY VERSE: Ephesians 4:28; Let him that stole steal no more: but rather, working with his hands the things which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Proverbs 6:9-11
INTRODUCTION
Greediness is the reason many young people have fallen into traps or died untimely. They are in a hurry to make money from every possible means, either legal or illegal. Joseph followed through the process, he endured the hardship and enjoyed later. In other hand, Gezahi wants to outsmart his master and become rich suddenly, but it boomeranged. Youths are carrying out illegal activities to make quick money. Many of them are languishing in the prison, some were butchered by the people who financed the extravagant lifestyle, some have been used for ritual, and some have been sold to foreign lands as prostitute.
LESSON OUTLINES
SMARTNESS OF THE YOUTH:
The youths do not want to work, but they want to enjoy. The way out of penury still remains work. Activities youth carry out to make money. (Eccl 4:5,
Prostitution (Aristo, jigolo)
Internet fraud (Yahoo, picker)
Drug pushing
Gambling (
Bet
Stealing (Arm robbery, picking pockets)
Money laundering
WORK:
Work is the spiritual and moral way of making money. It adds value to both the worker and the employer. For example; if a man hires a bricklayer to do some fencing work for him. After the fencing is completed, both the hirer and the bricklayer would be happy. The bricklayer would be happy that he got money, the hirer would be happy that value has been added to his land. But other means of making money outside work would make some to be happy, and some would be crying.  (Prov 10:4, Prov 12:24,
CONSEQUENCES OF SHORTCUTS
It cuts the lifespan. Many has met untimely death as a result of cutting corners (Jer 17:11, Prov 21:25)
It brings generational curses.
Whatsoever is gathered illegal will eventual be lost (Eccl 5:14)
It will deprive you peace of mind
Shortcuts damages reputation
APPLICATION
Do not be deceived, work is the legal route out of poverty.

title: THE HOLY SPIRIT

lesson_aim: This is the dispensation of the Holy Spirit. Every believer must be filled with the Holy Spirit.
application: Get rid of the filth in your life and let the Holy Spirit occupy the place.

Get rid of the filth in your life and let the Holy Spirit occupy the place.

title: THE FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT
memory_verse: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
introduction: Last week, we discussed on the works of the Holy Spirit in the lives of Christians and we highlighted that Holy Spirit transforms our lives. As we continue in the pursuit of becoming like Christ, Holy Spirit convicts us of bad behaviours, which we will repent of and ask for forgiveness. We will drop the old way of bad character and start exhibiting new ones, which is the life transformation we talked about. The new character is the fruit of the spirit.
lesson_aim: Fruit of the spirit are evidence of the transformation by the Holy Spirit.
application: Exhibition of the fruit of the spirit is the evidence that you have truly met Christ and He has changed your life.
raw_text:
TOPIC: THE FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT
AIM: Fruit of the spirit are evidence of the transformation by the Holy Spirit.
MEMORY VERSE: Matthew 7:20; Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
BIBLE PASSAGE: Galatians 5:22-23
INTRODUCTION
Last week, we discussed on the works of the Holy Spirit in the lives of Christians and we highlighted that Holy Spirit transforms our lives. As we continue in the pursuit of becoming like Christ, Holy Spirit convicts us of bad behaviours, which we will repent of and ask for forgiveness. We will drop the old way of bad character and start exhibiting new ones, which is the life transformation we talked about. The new character is the fruit of the spirit.
LESSON OUTLINES
FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT:
Fruit of the spirit is the physical evidence reflecting in change of behaviour, that is from bad to good. It is a prove that someone has encountered Christ and is filled with the Holy Spirit. Galatians 5:22-23 mentioned the fruit of the spirit to be love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness and temperance. If this fruit is lacking in your life, you need a life transformation by the Holy Spirit.
CLOSE YOUR EARS TO PEOPLEâS OPINION:
Expressing the fruit of the Spirit might make you forego your right, forgive your offenders and many. People might refer to you as being a fool or stupid. Do not give room for their opinion. Jesus encouraged us to receive the kingdom of God like a child (Matthew 18:3). Children have clean minds, they do not keep malice or grudges, and they show genuine love and kindness to themselves. That is the type of heart God is expecting from us.
LIFE APPLICATION
Exhibition of the fruit of the spirit is the evidence that you have truly met Christ and He has changed your life.

title: ESO TI EMI
memory_verse: Nitorina nipa eso won li enyin o fi mo won.
introduction: Ni ose ti o koja, a soro lori ise Emi mimo ni aye Kristeni, a si so wipe Emi mimo ma yi aye  wa pada. Bi a se ntesiwaju pelu ilepa lati dabi Jesu, Emi mimo ma nba iwa buruku wi ninu aye wa, eyi ti o ronupiwada, a o si toro idariji fun. A o fi igbeaye atijo yi sile, a o sib ere si ni iwu iwa otun, eyi ni iyipada aye eniyan ti a nsoro nipa. Iwa otun yi ni eso emi.
lesson_aim: Eso emi je eri iyipada otun ti Emi mimo ti se ni aye eniyan.
application: Fifi eso ti emi ni eri wipe looto lati ba Kristi pade, o si ti yi aye wa pada.

AKORI EKO: ESO TI EMI
ERONGBA: Eso emi je eri iyipada otun ti Emi mimo ti se ni aye eniyan.
AKOSORI: Matteu 7:20; Nitorina nipa eso won li enyin o fi mo won.
BIBELI KIKA: Galatia 5:22-23
ORO AKOSO
Ni ose ti o koja, a soro lori ise Emi mimo ni aye Kristeni, a si so wipe Emi mimo ma yi aye  wa pada. Bi a se ntesiwaju pelu ilepa lati dabi Jesu, Emi mimo ma nba iwa buruku wi ninu aye wa, eyi ti o ronupiwada, a o si toro idariji fun. A o fi igbeaye atijo yi sile, a o sib ere si ni iwu iwa otun, eyi ni iyipada aye eniyan ti a nsoro nipa. Iwa otun yi ni eso emi.
PINPIN EKO
ESO EMI:
Eso emi ni eri ti o awon eniyan leri ti o farahan nipa iyipada iwa, eyi nipe eniti o wu iwa buburu bere si ni wu iwa rere. O je eri wipe eniyan na ti ba Kristi pada, o si ti kun fun Emi mimo. Galatia 5:22-23 ka eso emi, eyini ni ife, ayo, alafia, ipamora, iwa pele, isore, igbagbo, iwa tutu ati ikora-eni-nijanu. Ti eso ko ba si ninu aye re, aye nilo iyipada lati odo Emi mimo.
DI ETI RE SI OHUN TI AWON ENIYAN NSO:
Fifi eso emi han le mu padanu awon eto re, wa dariji awon ti o se o ati beebee lo. Awon eniyan le pe o ni ode tabi ago. Mase fi eti oro won. Jesu gba wa niyanju lati gba ijoba orun bi awon omode (Matteu 18:3). Awon omode ni okan ti o mo, won ki ngbe oro ninu, won ma fi ife otito han. Iru okan ti Olorun nreti lodo wa niyi.
LILO EKO NA
Fifi eso ti emi ni eri wipe looto lati ba Kristi pade, o si ti yi aye wa pada.

title: GIFT OF THE SPIRIT
memory_verse: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
introduction: Spiritual gifts are skills and abilities given to faithful believers to serve God and for the edification of the church of God. God is empowering us for His service. lesson_aim: The gift of the Spirit is for the edification of the church.
application: All the gifts are important in the church and no one is inferior to the other. Use your gift for the edification of the church, profit of the body of Christ and to glorify God

Eleyi je okan lara awon ami bibo Jesu leekeji. O se pataki lati mo bi a ti a se mo awon asotele eke, ki ibi ma ba yo wole, ti awon omo ijo a si di ije fun won.
PINPIN EKO
EBUN DIDA EMI MO YATO
Ebun ida emi mo je okan lara awon ebun Emi mimo ti o se pataki ninu ijo Olorun. Bibeli so wipe satani ma nparada si angeli imole (II Kor 11:13-15). Idi ti awon emi okun ati awon iranse se ma se tan awon eniyan je. (II Tim 3:6-8):
Larin yi oro Olorun pada, ki gbogbo nkan si di tutu.
Lati da iporuru, ede aiyede ati aimokan silu nipa gbigbin eko odi.
Lati ko awon eniyan ni ifa. (Ki won gba owo won tabi ki won ba se ifekufe)
Lati ni ero ni inu egbe okunkun won, ki won si ti won lo si orun apadi
Lati tan awon eniyan, ki won si ma dari aye won
Won ma da eru ba awon eniyan, paapaa julo pelu iku. (II Tim 1:7)
BI A SE LE SORA FUN AWON ITANJE YI
Ki ijo Olorun ma ko eko otito. Opolopo awon ti won ma ntete ri tanje je awon eniyan ti ko mo otito â Hosea 4: 6
Itoni ati ibawi (II Tim 4:2) â Ijo ati awon adari isori kookan ninu ijo gbodo mu iduro lati ba enikeni wi ati nigbati won ri wipe asotele kan je eke.
Awon woli gbodo teriba fun awon adari won ninu emi. Awon asotele kan wa ti o je wipe awon adari ijo koko gbodo gbo. Asotele wa fun irusoke ijo Olorun, ki se fun ifi ara eni han.
Asotele o gbodo je nitori owo tabi ebun ti enikan fun wa. Ki si oja ti a nta. (Ise Aposteli 8:20)
Mo wipe ni opolopo igba, Olorun ma fi asiri nkan han nitori o fe yo eniyan ninu ewu tabi ra eniyan pada, nitorina mase je ki woli kankan tan o je pelu awon asotele eru. Lo si odo Olorun ninu adura, bebe fun idariji ese ati anu.
LILO EKO NA
Aimokan tabi aini oye je idi ti opolopo se di ije fun awon woli eke ati asotele won. Gbiyanju lati mo Olorun, o si ni di ije fun tabi wa bo lowo etan won.

title: DISCERNMENT
memory_verse: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good
introduction: One of the ways God speaks to His people is by sending preacher/prophets to them (Rom 10:14). People have used this means for their personal gains and as a result perverse the message or deliver the message they are not sent. This is one of the signs of the second coming of the Lord Jesus Christ. It is important to know how to identify fake prophecies so that evil will not creep in and members will not become preys.
lesson_aim: Discernment is one of the gifts of the Holy Spirit.
application: Ignorance is the reason many people are preys to fake prophet and their prophecies. Strive to know God personally and you will never be a victim or be free from their manipulations.
raw_text:
TOPIC: DISCERNMENT
AIM: Discernment is one of the gifts of the Holy Spirit.
MEMORY VERSE: I Thess 5:21; Prove all things; hold fast that which is good
BIBLE PASSAGE: Acts 13:6-12
INTRODUCTION
One of the ways God speaks to His people is by sending preacher/prophets to them (Rom 10:14). People have used this means for their personal gains and as a result perverse the message or deliver the message they are not sent. This is one of the signs of the second coming of the Lord Jesus Christ. It is important to know how to identify fake prophecies so that evil will not creep in and members will not become preys.
LESSON OUTLINES
GIFT OF DISCERNMENT
Gift of discernment is one of the gift of the Holy Spirit and it is important in the church of God. Bible explained that Satan transforms into angel of light (II Cor 11:13-15). The purpose of this manipulation by Satan and his servants (II Tim 3:6-8):
To dilute the truth and cause lukewarmness
To cause confusion by planting heresies
To get personal gains (Monetary gains or lustful satisfaction)
To populate their coven of darkness and hell
To manipulate and control followers
They create unnecessary fear, especially about death (II Tim 1:7)
HOW TO GUIDE AGAINST THIS MANIPULATION
The church should teach the truth. Many of those who are easily manipulated are people who do not know the truth â Hosea 4: 6
Correction and reproof (II Tim 4:2) â Church/unit leaders should be firm in correcting and when they discover that a prophecy is not real
Prophets should be submissive to their spiritual leader. Some prophecies should be shared with church leaders first. The prophecy is to edify the body of Christ and not to show off.
Prophecies should not be triggered by money or gift. It is not a merchandise to be sold. (Acts 8:20)
Know that in most cases, God always reveal in order to redeem/save someone, therefore do not let any prophet to extort you with fearful prophecies. Go to God in prayer, seek repentance and mercy.
LESSON APPLICATION
Ignorance is the reason many people are preys to fake prophet and their prophecies. Strive to know God personally and you will never be a victim or be free from their manipulations.

title: ILANA TI O MU NA
memory_verse: Mase ye ala ile igbani, ti awon baba re ti pa. ALAGBASE Johanu 10:13; Alagbase sa lo nitoriti ise alagbase, ko si nani awon agutan.
introduction:
Ilana tumo si kiko eniyan tabi tito eniyan sona. Ilana je oun gbogbo ti Bibeli so nipa igbagbo Kristeni. Ti a ba nsoro nipa igbagbo bayi, o tumo si awon oun ti Bibeli fi ko wa labe awon akori kookan. Fun bi apere, oun ti bibeli so nipa igbala, metalokan, idariji ati imupadabosipo, igbeyawo, idamewa, iwoso, isin ati awon akori miran.
Lati ara oruko, alagbase, o tumo si wipe, o je ise fun elomiran ni lati ma ba bojuto awon agutan. Oun to mu wa se ise na ni bi yio se gbo bukata ara re (Jobu 7:2). Sugbon Oluso-agutan ti o ni agutan, idi ti oun fi se ise na ni ki awon agutan wa ni Alafia, o si ni idunu ninu alafia ati igbadun awon aguntan (Orin Dafidi 23). Opolopo alagbase ni o po larin awon ti won je iranse Olorun. Won nfun awon agutan gbe lairo iru isoro ti o gbe agutan de odo won. Ni arin onigbagbo, Alagbase je enikeni ti ki se olusoagutan re (Baba re ninu Oluwa ti o n fi ounje emi bo o, ti o si mo o gegebi okan lara agutan re)
lesson_aim: Ilana ti o mu na gbodo mu iyipada ba aye awon eniyan.
application:
Se agbeyewo awon eko ti o ti ngbo, se o yi aye re pada si dida bi Kristi?
Duro ni ala oreofe ti Olorun ti fi o si. Sisa lati ibi kan si ikeji ko ni mu iyato kankan wa.
raw_text:
AKORI EKO: ILANA TI O MU NA
ERONGBA: Ilana ti o mu na gbodo mu iyipada ba aye awon eniyan.
AKOSORI: Owe 22:28;  Mase ye ala ile igbani, ti awon baba re ti pa.
BIBELI KIKA: II Timoteu 3:16-17
ORO AKOSO
Ilana tumo si kiko eniyan tabi tito eniyan sona. Ilana je oun gbogbo ti Bibeli so nipa igbagbo Kristeni. Ti a ba nsoro nipa igbagbo bayi, o tumo si awon oun ti Bibeli fi ko wa labe awon akori kookan. Fun bi apere, oun ti bibeli so nipa igbala, metalokan, idariji ati imupadabosipo, igbeyawo, idamewa, iwoso, isin ati awon akori miran.
PINPIN EKO
PATAKI EKO TI O MU NA
O jeki a mo otito ninu aye ti o kun iro ati etan.
O je ipile lati ma wu iwa gegebi Kristeni
O njeki a ma ala wa
O duro gegebi itoni ati iso fun wa (Owe 22:28)
O n jeki a gbe igbese ti o ba ife Olorun mu
BAWO NI A SELE DA ILANA TI O TO MO
Ilana ti o to duro lori oro Olorun.
O wa ni ibamu pelu awon iwa Kristi
O lodi si ese
Ki saba se nkan ti a feran lati gbo
O ma dari eniyan lati wu iwa rere.
ILANA ATI BI AYE ENIYAN SE N YIPADA
Ilana je ipile fun iyipada aye eniyan eyi ti Olorun nreti. Leyin ti a ti mo Kristi, ife Olorun gbodo di mimo fun eniti o sese fi aye re fun Jesu (eyi ni kiko ni ilana Olorun). Ilana ti mu na (Ti o to) gbodo mu ki eniyan ma wu iwa bi Kristi (iyidapa iwa), Ilana ti o to ki se lati yan eni na je tabi gba owo lowo re (II Tim 3:16-17). Gbogbo eko ti ko ba ti ni otun-iwa gegebi afojusun re tabi won yi oro Olorun po lati fi gba owo lowo eniyan, sa fun iru ipejopo be.
LILO EKO NA
Se agbeyewo awon eko ti o ti ngbo, se o yi aye re pada si dida bi Kristi?
AKORI: ALAGBASE
ERONGBA: The purpose of the hireling is self centred
AKOSORI:  Johanu 10:13; Alagbase sa lo nitoriti ise alagbase, ko si nani awon agutan.
BIBELI KIKA: Johanu 10:12-13
ORO AKOSO
Lati ara oruko, alagbase, o tumo si wipe, o je ise fun elomiran ni lati ma ba bojuto awon agutan. Oun to mu wa se ise na ni bi yio se gbo bukata ara re (Jobu 7:2). Sugbon Oluso-agutan ti o ni agutan, idi ti oun fi se ise na ni ki awon agutan wa ni Alafia, o si ni idunu ninu alafia ati igbadun awon aguntan (Orin Dafidi 23). Opolopo alagbase ni o po larin awon ti won je iranse Olorun. Won nfun awon agutan gbe lairo iru isoro ti o gbe agutan de odo won. Ni arin onigbagbo, Alagbase je enikeni ti ki se olusoagutan re (Baba re ninu Oluwa ti o n fi ounje emi bo o, ti o si mo o gegebi okan lara agutan re)
PINPIN EKO
AWON IWA ALAGBASE:
Yio wu iwa pe Alagbase ni oun: Alagbase je eniti a gba lati soju eniyan tabi ba eniyan se ise. Ki wu iwa bi pe oun ni o ni awon agutan. Iwa aibikita ma nwa ninu iwa won. Olusoagutan yio dide lati fie mi re la ewu koja fun awon agutan, ki ibi ma ba ba won (1 Sam 17:34-35). Melo ninu awon woli ati awon iranse Olorun ti o nsato lo le dide lati gbadura fun o? Se won o ma fun o gbe?
Ibasepo: Ibasepo ti o dara wa larin oluso agutan ati agutan. Oluso agutan mo nkan ti awon agutan yio je, bi won yio se je ati nkan ti ko ni damu ilera won. Alagbase je alakoso pajawiri tabi alabojuto pajawiri ti o mo bi awon agutan se nwu iwa tele. Yio kan bo won gegebi o ba ti gba lero. Iru nkan ti opolopo awon woli ati iranse Olorun ti o wa ni ode ti o yato si oluso agutan re yio se niyi. Awon ko lo ni agutan.
Alagbase ko ni gbiyanju lati se laala die si nitori o fe tea won agutan lorun. Awon iranse Olorun tooto o waasu, gbadura, gba eniyan ni amoran, to eniyan sona, won bojuto omo ijo, won si ni ipa ninu gbogbo igbese aye awon omo ijo. Won nse eleyi lai reti ere nipa ti owo. Ti awon omo ijo ba fun won, won a gba sugbon ko je dandan.
Alagbase ma nsa. Ti gbogbo nkan ba nse daradara, alagbase a duro. Sugbon ti nkan o ba se daradara mo, alagbase a sa lo.
Alagbase le seto ona lati jale. Oro aye eniyan ni ki eniyan ba Oluso agutan so, ki eniyan ma ba alagbase so. Gen 30:37-43.
Alagbase ki ba awon agutan wi nitori won o ni ibasepo ti o le mu ki o ba won wi. Won kan ma fi owo pa won lori ati ki won mu inu won dun, ki won ba le ri nkan ti won fe gba lowo won gba.
LILO EKO NA
Duro ni ala oreofe ti Olorun ti fi o si. Sisa lati ibi kan si ikeji ko ni mu iyato kankan wa.

title: SOUND DOCTRINE

introduction: The word doctrine means teaching or instruction. Doctrine means what the entire bible says about Christiansâ faith. Faith here means what bible says on each particular subject. For example, what bible teaches on salvation, trinity, forgiveness/restitution, marriage, tithe, dressing, worship and others.
lesson_aim: Sound doctrine should lead to life transformation
application: Evaluate the teaching you have been hearing/getting, has it changed your life to becoming like Christ?
raw_text:
TOPIC: SOUND DOCTRINE
AIM: Sound doctrine should lead to life transformation
MEMORY VERSE: Proverbs 22:28; Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
BIBLE PASSAGE: II Timothy 3:16-17
INTRODUCTION
The word doctrine means teaching or instruction. Doctrine means what the entire bible says about Christiansâ faith. Faith here means what bible says on each particular subject. For example, what bible teaches on salvation, trinity, forgiveness/restitution, marriage, tithe, dressing, worship and others.
LESSON OUTLINES
SIGNIFICANCE OF SOUND DOCTRINE
It helps us ascertain the truth in a world of falsehood
It serves as foundation for Christian behaviour
It defines our boundaries
It serves as a guard and guide to us (Prov 22:28)
It helps us to make Godly decisions
HOW TO IDENTIFY SOUND DOCTRINE
It is centred on Godâs word
It is consistent with Christâs personality
It is against sin
It is not always what you want to hear
It leads to good behaviour
DOCTRINE AND LIFE TRANSFORMATION
Doctrine is the basis for the basis for the transformation of life which God is expecting. After knowing Christ, the will of God should be exposed to the new convert (that is teaching the person the doctrine). Sound doctrine should lead to becoming like Christ (life transformation) and not a way to exploit and extort the new convert (II Tim 3:16-17). Any teaching that does not focus on life transformation or it is perverse in order to extort, run away from such gathering.
LIFE APPLICATION
Evaluate the teaching you have been hearing/getting, has it changed your life to becoming like Christ?
